content.value_statement: Security reviews can miss important controls across applications, infrastructure, and supply chains. This skill provides framework-based checklists and a consistent finding format for focused reviews.
actual_capabilities: Guides threat modeling with STRIDE categories and trust boundaries.
Structures findings with severity, impact, recommendation, and references.
Reviews application controls using OWASP Top 10 and ASVS checklists.
Assesses dependency, CI/CD, provenance, and release controls.
Provides focused review checklists for cryptography, smart contracts, and ZK circuits.
limitations: Does not execute security scanners or validate a running system.
Does not replace a qualified penetration test or independent audit.
Requires accurate system context and source material from the user.
Provides guidance and findings, not compliance certification.

use_cases.title: Review an application pull request
use_cases.description: Identify authorization, input handling, session, and logging controls that need review.

use_cases.title: Assess delivery pipeline controls
use_cases.description: Review dependencies, CI permissions, artifact integrity, and release provenance.

use_cases.title: Prepare a protocol security review
use_cases.description: Check contract invariants, key custody, ZK constraints, and proof verification assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Start a web application review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this web application component using the OWASP checklist. List the highest-priority questions and missing evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Model a service threat
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a STRIDE threat model for this service. Identify trust boundaries, assets, threats, and recommended controls.

prompt_templates.title: Assess supply chain controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repository delivery process against SLSA and OpenSSF guidance. Prioritize gaps in dependencies, CI/CD, and releases.

prompt_templates.title: Review a ZK circuit design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this ZK circuit design for constraint soundness, range checks, transcript binding, and verifier assumptions. Return findings in the specified format.

output_examples.input: Review an API endpoint that uses role checks but does not verify resource ownership.
output: Impact: A user may access another user’s records.
Recommendation: Enforce ownership or policy checks for every requested resource.

output_examples.input: Assess a release workflow with unpinned actions and broad token permissions.
output: Impact: A changed external action could affect release artifacts.
Recommendation: Pin actions to immutable revisions and minimize token permissions.

best_practices: Define scope, assets, trust boundaries, and authorization before beginning a review.
Prioritize findings by realistic impact, exploitability, and available evidence.
Record assumptions and validate recommendations with the owning team.
anti_patterns: Do not treat checklist completion as proof that a system is secure.
Do not report findings without a clear location, impact, and remediation path.
Do not test systems without explicit authorization and an agreed scope.

faq.question: What frameworks does this skill use?
faq.answer: It references NIST CSF, CIS Controls, NIST SSDF, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, SLSA, and OpenSSF guidance.

faq.question: Can this skill perform penetration testing?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance and does not execute tests or scans.

faq.question: Can I use it for code reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. Use it to structure security questions and findings for pull requests or architecture changes.

faq.question: Does it cover supply chain security?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes dependency, CI/CD, build provenance, and release-process checklists.

faq.question: Does it support blockchain reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for smart contracts and ZK circuit security reviews.

faq.question: Does it provide compliance certification?
faq.answer: No. It helps organize evidence and controls, but it does not certify compliance.
